thread:
sara: FYI customers hitting weird behavior after upgrading SDK: sessions being reaped every 60s even though we set SESSION_LIFETIME=600 in k8s. looks like the env parsing turned the int into a string somewhere.
mike: ugh. typical k8s string-in-env pain. any logs?
sara: log sample from app pod:
```
2026-03-25T14:11:02Z INFO pool: configured_session_lifetime="600" reap_interval=60
2026-03-25T14:11:02Z WARN reaper: parsed_lifetime=60 (default) because parse_int failed
```
zayn: so the SDK fell back to default 60s because parse_int returned None. Where do we parse envs? I thought PoolConfig has typing.
mike: apparently not for env loader. PR #478 added PoolConfig type hints but env loader still uses os.getenv + int() wrapped in try/except that swallows errors. we've had this exact class of bug before.
sara: customer impact: increased TLS handshakes and p95 for small requests. they copied example quickstart which shows envs as strings in k8s manifest. onboarding friction.
docs-bot: note: quickstart still shows SESSION_LIFETIME: "600" (string) in example k8s manifest. recommend change to no quotes.\ayn: (typo) zayn: Also this exposed a UX gap: when env parsing fails we should emit a warning with telemetry tag so SRE/dev can see misconfigs. Right now it silently falls back.
mike: plan: 1) tighten PoolConfig parsing to use typed parsing util that logs parse errors, 2) add validation on startup that emits metric `sdk.config.parse_errors` with tag key=env_name, 3) update quickstart examples to show unquoted numeric env values for common envs (SESSION_LIFETIME, POOL_SEMAPHORE).
sara: can we also add pydantic models for PoolConfig public API so consumers using python config objects get type errors early?
\ayn: zayn: yes add Pydantic/typed dataclass and export PoolConfig in top-level module. That helps typing in IDEs and reduces onboarding errors.
ci-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-python-sdk/issues/441 with repro, logs, and suggested fixes.
mike: I'll open a small PR to change env loader and emit metric + startup warning. also will update docs. assigning to @mike and @zayn.
sara: short-term mitigation for affected customers: set RW_SESSION_LIFETIME as integer in k8s (no quotes) or set via configmap mounted file parsed by SDK. We pushed a note to support templates.
docs-bot: quickstart PR #489 opened to fix examples and add a short "common env pitfalls" section.
zayn: follow-ups: add unit test where os.environ contains quoted values to ensure parsing warns. add integration test mimicking k8s string env to catch regressions.
mike: thanks team. will push patch today. :rocket:
